_how_to: House items from Nordic Crypto, shown by newsletter/digest.py in a 'From Nordic Crypto' block after the intro, in every issue whose --until date falls within [from, until] (Oslo dates). Not news stories: rendered without the bold story link, so tools/fb_newsletter.py, tools/x_newsletter.py and tools/social_translate.py do not pick them up as stories. text: list of paragraphs; a paragraph that is a list of strings becomes a numbered list, {"ul": [...]} a bulleted list. Languages without a translation fall back to English.

title.en: The Nordic Crypto Shield is here

en: The Nordic Crypto Shield is a collectible badge on the Nexa blockchain, in an edition of 1,000. It is free from Nordic Crypto; you only pay a small Nexa network fee.
Install Wally Wallet for iPhone or Android.
Tap "Mint in Wally Wallet" (on a computer, scan the QR code) and confirm.
The Shield is a collectible badge only, with no economic rights. Every mint shows up under "Recent mints" with a link to the transaction.
Coming tomorrow: the Nordic Crypto Explorer, for Bitcoin, Bitcoin Cash and Nexa in one place. Join the chat: https://t.me/nordiccryptochat

Slik får du ditt i tre steg:
Installer Wally Wallet for iPhone eller Android.
Trykk «Mint in Wally Wallet» (på datamaskin: skann QR-koden) og bekreft.
Shield er bare et samlemerke, uten økonomiske rettigheter. Hver mint vises under «Recent mints» med lenke til transaksjonen.
Kommer i morgen: Nordic Crypto Explorer, for Bitcoin, Bitcoin Cash og Nexa på ett sted. Bli med i chatten: https://t.me/nordiccryptochat
